ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 你很激动嘛

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
是吗，
一大早就笑嘻嘻的，
我可不认为这叫正常

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 难道说，你找到新的乐队成员了？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 那就是原班人马吗。真好啊

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
『Notria』『Jasmy＆Husky』
『Disruption』

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
不是你问的吗。
总之，恭喜你

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 一直有人在给你发消息哦

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
『现在在哪』『出来』『出来啊』『至少看一下吧』。
你真是受欢迎呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 不去参加乐队练习没关系吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
原来如此……
你失落的时候很安静，真不错呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
再见。
我还要去乐队，先回去了

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
能为自己的乐队而烦恼，
我其实有点羡慕

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
久等了。
如果你们在忙的话，我就先出去？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我是八幡海铃。
在大概30支乐队中兼职，不介意的话就好

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
不过，实际在活动的大概有10支左右吧。
提前一个星期联系我的话，我会尽可能参加的

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
唔……
大概情况我明白了

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……看来你们还没忘记前任呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
贝斯手的事情，
请你们内部讨论好之后，再和我商量吧

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
那么……
我会为你们加油的

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我打算提前到17点。
三角同学，你后面有安排吧

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.text: ……？怎么了？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 哦哦，原来你吃醋了吗

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_022
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
乐队的事情，好像圆满解决了呢。
如果还需要帮忙的话，随时找我
